task: Falsify Agent Dispatch vanilla runtime workflow

workflow_dispatch_only.details: The workflow triggers exclusively on workflow_dispatch with bounded inputs.

bounded_inputs.details: workset_id, delegation_id, assignment_id, and version are bounded inputs validated in step 2 against regex ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,95}$ via environment variables.

run_name_correlation.details: run-name uses sidecar:${{ inputs.workset_id }}:${{ inputs.delegation_id }}:${{ inputs.assignment_id }} matching the three Agent Dispatch correlation fields.

permissions_read_only.details: Workflow declares permissions: contents: read explicitly.

no_repository_write_push.details: No steps perform git push, commit, or repository mutation.

no_secret_credential_exposure.details: No secret tokens or private repository credentials are referenced or exposed. Checkout sets persist-credentials: false.

ubuntu_24_04_public_runner.details: runs-on is set to ubuntu-24.04 standard public runner.

action_shas_pinned.details: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262, actions/setup-java@ad2b38190b15e4d6bdf0c97fb4fca8412226d287, and actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 are pinned to immutable SHAs.

release_identity_required.details: Step 2 requires existence of probes/$MC_VERSION-release-identity.json before starting the runtime.

reuses_existing_runtime_script.details: Reuses existing tools/smoke_vanilla_runtime.py without code duplication.

real_evidence_included.details: Smoke output captures real status handshake, expected protocol version, and server artifact SHA-256.

correlation_receipt_hashing.details: Receipt calculates smoke_sha256 over full smoke output JSON and records GITHUB_SHA, GITHUB_REPOSITORY, RUNNER_OS, and RUNNER_ARCH.

public_safe_artifact_upload.details: Artifact upload is public-safe, uploading only vanilla-runtime-smoke.json and receipt.json from runner temp.

malicious_input_falsification.details: Challenged injection, path traversal, newline, and length overflow input shapes against the regex validation step; all invalid shapes were rejected.

syntax_and_heredoc_correctness.details: YAML structure, GitHub Actions expressions, and python heredocs (<<'PY') were validated for correct syntax and variable suppression.
